dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset consists of 205 videos of 'pseudosigns' that were originally created for experimental use with signers of Dutch Sign Language or NGT (Nederlandse Gebarentaal). A file with the list of all video filenames is also included. Each pseudosign has the length and prosody of a regular NGT sign, but had no lexical meaning in NGT when the videos were created (in 2013). Note that the development of these stimuli was influenced by the work and authors of the following study: Emmory, K., Borinstein, H. B., Thompson, R., & Gollan, T. H. (2008). Bimodal bilingualism. Bilingualism: Language and Cognition, 11(1): 43–61. doi:10.1017/S1366728907003203

fields.value: (1) With regard to the numbering of the pseudosigns in the filenames, four were removed after the numbering was finalised. Thus, pseudosigns 043, 130, 133, and 167 are not in the dataset. Also, two versions of pseudosign 056 were kept in the dataset: 056a and 056b.
